Description

Casual matches available on weekend during the football season, please call to book.

There are four 11 a side football pitches available for hire at the Wanstead Flats Playing Fields (Harrow Road) on a grass surface. It is situated in City of London, East London and the nearest tube is Leytonstone High Road Station (Overground). All the facilities are available on a pay as you go basis
